description: Log group expenses and get the minimal set of settle-up payments.

faqs.a: For each expense enter who paid, how much, and who shared it (comma-separated names). The tool computes balances and the fewest transfers to settle.
The balances are netted: each person ends with a single owed amount, then a greedy algorithm pairs debtors with creditors so nobody makes more payments than needed.
No — it supports a free-form group; just use consistent names for each person.
Yes, the expense log is stored in this browser's localStorage.

howto: Enter who paid, the amount, and who shared the expense.
Click Add Expense — repeat for every expense.
Click Calculate Settle-Up to see who pays whom.
The result is the minimal set of transfers to even out.
title: Expense Splitter
